svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two: 6 mm plate 80 wide x 100 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 26.0 hole for the coil tail, centred across, 35 above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge: a sliding fit on the 25.4 tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 7 mm holes for the M6 studs, 56 apart across and 76 apart

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld four M6 studs to the shell round each slot to suit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: pack the slot round the tail with 12 mm ceramic rope, slide the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate over the tail end, and nip the nuts so the rope seals but

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the tube can still slide as it grows when hot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the plates before the unions go on the tail ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the tube slides in the plate by hand.
